mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 3.0% signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.0%, or the average 20d return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in over 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.05 million units signals strong household demand and rising inflationary pressures, leading to expectations of prolonged monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1050.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 103.0 index level signals weakening manufacturing activity and a contraction in real output, which triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60d returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 103.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS signal a persistent inflationary environment where the Fed is actively responding, leading to higher real rates and reduced equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances where both CPIAUCSL > 240.0 and FEDFUNDS > 0.3%, or the joint signal fails to produce a statistically significant negative return (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 465 billion dollars, combined with rising housing starts, signals strong aggregate demand and overheating in the economy, leading to expectations of rate hikes and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances where both RSAFS > 465000.0 and HOUST > 1040.0, or the joint signal fails to produce a statistically significant negative return (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in non-farm payroll growth signals a labor market that is both tight and expanding, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 5.0% and PAYEMS > 144000.0, or the joint signal fails to produce a statistically significant negative return (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) above 16700 billion dollars, combined with rising industrial production, signals strong economic momentum that increases inflationary pressures and prompts the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60d returns in more than 60% of periods when both GDPC1 > 16700 and INDPRO > 104.0, or the joint signal fails to produce a statistically significant negative return (t-test p > 0.05).
